definitions.gloss: in all sincerity, with one's whole heart
definitions.explanation: Acting with complete sincerity and dedication; putting one's whole heart into something.

examples.japanese: {誠心誠意|せいしんせいい}⟦お{詫|わ}び→詫びる：14174_wabiru⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: I sincerely apologize from the bottom of my heart.

examples.japanese: {誠心誠意|せいしんせいい}⟦{尽|つ}くします→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いします→お願いする：05654_onegaisuru⟧。
examples.english: I will do my utmost with complete sincerity, so please count on me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{誠心誠意|せいしんせいい}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: He dealt with the matter with complete sincerity.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧):
{誠心|せいしん} (sincere heart) + ⟦{誠意|せいい}→誠意：19759_seii⟧ (sincerity)

ETYMOLOGY:
- {誠|せい}: sincerity, truth
- {心|しん}: heart, mind
- ⟦{意|い}→意：30489_i⟧: intention, meaning
"With sincere heart and sincere intention" - doubling the concept of sincerity for emphasis.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {誠心誠意|せいしんせいい}⟦お{詫|わ}び→詫びる：14174_wabiru⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to apologize most sincerely)
- {誠心誠意|せいしんせいい}⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧ (to devote oneself wholeheartedly)
- {誠心誠意|せいしんせいい}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to respond with complete sincerity)

REGISTER:
Formal. Often used in business contexts, apologies, or when emphasizing genuine commitment. Very common in customer service language.
